definitions.latency: client-side wall time per request, request sent to answer parsed; compare only rows with the same requests_in_flight
definitions.api_cost_per_1000_usd_list_price: per 1,000 questions, at list price (price_source, price_date), not an invoice; cost_basis says which: a billed route's input tokens at its list price (for a chat model billed per token through OpenRouter, input and output tokens, reasoning included), or a subscription run's ESTIMATE: the input (cache reads at the cached rate) and output tokens its route REPORTS, at the maker's API list rate in force on the run's days (price_note), $0 billed, not a reconstructed invoice; null on own GPU, on a subscription run whose usage is incomplete or invalid or whose days cross a rate change, and with its rate, source and date where no public price page backs that exact model's rate (checked 13 Nov): unverified, not zero
definitions.cost_basis: 'billed route at API list price', 'estimated: subscription at API list price' (the tokens a subscription run's route reports, harness context included where it counts it, priced as if sent to the maker's API), 'subscription: not estimated', or null (own GPU, or no backed price)
definitions.price_note: for a subscription estimate: the rate period used, its input, output and cached input rates, and how the route counts its usage, with any known under-count
definitions.gpu_seconds_per_1000: measured wall time of the whole run on one GPU (model load excluded) over all pairs it answered, per 1,000 questions: a rate, not a cohort share; own GPU only, not comparable with API dollars
definitions.recall: of all gold pairs with that label, the share labelled so; an invalid reply counts as missed
definitions.wrong_answer_recall: recall_other: texts stating a conflicting answer that were flagged 'other'
definitions.false_alarm_rate: gold 'reference' or 'none' pairs labelled 'other', over false_alarm_pairs; invalid replies are not counted as correct rejections, so 1 - false_alarm_rate is not an accuracy; read it beside invalid
definitions.invalid: replies without a usable label; for chat, no last matching ANSWER marker in the visible output under answer rule v2 (keyword in any letter case, option an uppercase A, B or C); counted wrong
definitions.measurement_gap: present only where a run was interrupted and resumed: latency and gpu_seconds_per_1000 are then null, with the reason; scores are unaffected
definitions.probabilities: this run's records hold per-option probabilities for every pair; says nothing about other runs of the model; no confidence is derived for chat models; calibration_error stays in bench-scores.json
definitions.decision_score: Artificial Analysis's Decision Score: the mean over all pairs of 50 x (1 + c - (p - c)^2), p the probability the model gave its chosen label, c 1 if that label is right else 0 (100: sure and right; 0: sure and wrong); equals 50 x (1 + accuracy - chosen_answer_brier). Null for chat models (no probabilities) and for any run where a pair's p is missing or not in [0, 1], never over a subset
definitions.chosen_answer_brier: the mean over the same pairs of (p - c)^2 for the chosen label; lower is better
definitions.seed_groups: a row with 'runs' covers three full runs with seeds 0, 1, 2 under its first run's id: recalls and false_alarm_rate are the mean of the three, latency is over all their requests, gpu_seconds_per_1000 the mean rate; 'invalid' is null and each seed's count is in invalid_per_seed
